compute_GoliathCocoWholeBodyMetric_metri: compute Goliath and COCO-WholeBody pose estimation metrics from model prediction results
convert_results_goliath_to_coco_wholebod: convert Goliath 308-keypoint predictions to COCO-WholeBody format using keypoint index mapping
